subject: Provisional request: add 3 runtime infra seats + payband exception for Sr. SWE
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Provisional request: add 3 runtime infra seats + payband exception for Sr. SWE

Team —

Requesting approval to add three headcount slots to the runtime/infra org in Q1 hiring (two Senior Runtime SWE, one Staff/Principal SRE-focused role). Key asks:

- Add 3 HC: 2x Sr. Runtime SWE (IC4/IC5) + 1x Staff SRE (IC6 mix with infra/system reliability focus).
- One Sr. SWE slot to receive a payband exception (requesting +10% above standard band midpoint) to be competitive with the candidate pipeline (see attached comp-band analysis).
- Target start window: onboarding by 2027-02-01; recruiters have a shortlist (attached: Luis Herrera resume).

Rationale: sustained customer growth for dedicated pools and private deployments is increasing demand on model-serving capacity; we have recurring incidents tied to kernel/kv-cache edge cases that the current team cannot prioritize without dedicated hires. Marcus and I ran a projected throughput-cost model — net-new incremental OPEX is forecasted to be absorbed by reserved capacity margin (details in the PDF).

Attachments: runtime-hc-proposal-v2.pdf, comp-band-uplift-analysis.xlsx, Luis resume (from TalentWorks).

Asking for provisional approval to post roles and start offer conversations with strong candidates. If approved, I’ll route final offer letters for sign-off.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Platform Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional request: add 3 runtime infra seats + payband exception for Sr. SWE

Olga —

Thanks for the packet and the detailed breakdown. A few follow-ups before I can greenlight the exception:

1) Cost delta: can you call out the fully loaded cost (salary+benefits+onboarding) per role and the quarter-over-quarter budget impact? The comp sheet looks helpful but I want single-line FY27 delta.
2) Candidate justification: for the payband uplift, provide explicit market comps and the counterfactual (what happens if we keep to band). You have a promising candidate (Luis) — what’s his current comp and expected ask?
3) Roadmap alignment: confirm which outgoing priorities these hires will unblock (e.g., kernel isolation, prefix caching rollout).

If you can get that by EOD Monday I’ll escalate for exec approval.

-Kimberly
VP, Finance & People Ops (comp planning)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional request: add 3 runtime infra seats + payband exception for Sr. SWE

Kimberly / Olga —

Quick data to help the ask (see excerpt below from the proposal PDF):

- Fully loaded per Sr. SWE (current band): $220k base + 25% benefits/eq = ~$275k/year. With +10% exception target base ~242k => fully loaded ~$302k/year.
- Staff SRE fully loaded estimate: ~$380k/year.
- FY27 incremental run-rate across three hires (if hired by Feb): approximately $460k prorated remainder of FY27, full-year FY28 run-rate ~$960k.

Roadmap alignment: these hires are explicitly gating the Kernel Isolation work (security + latency wins for private deployments) and the KV-prefix caching rollout that cuts token cost by ~8% for high-throughput tenants. I attached the short roadmap slice in the PDF.

I support the +10% band for the first Sr. slot to secure top-tier candidates in this competitive market — losing them will delay the KV rollout by ~2 quarters given our current bench.

-Marcus
Director, Runtime Engineering

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional request: add 3 runtime infra seats + payband exception for Sr. SWE

Appreciate the packet. From recruiting ops:

- TalentWorks (Ava Reynolds) has two strong pipeline candidates for the Sr. roles and one for Staff SRE; Luis Herrera is the top match for Sr Runtime SWE with current comp around $240k base (total comp ~320k). I attached the Luis resume we received.
- Proposed interview panel: Marcus (tech lead), Soojin (hiring manager), two cross-team runtime engineers, and a CS partner. We can schedule loop interviews starting Dec 6.
- Timing note: if we want to close by Jan, offers need to go out by mid-December. Payband exception materially increases catch probability.

I’ll coordinate scheduling once we get provisional approval.

-Soojin
Senior Talent Partner

Team —

I’ve reviewed the numbers and Marcus’s summary. I’m happy to give provisional sign-off to post the roles and run the interview loop with the +10% payband uplift for the first Sr. SWE candidate only. Final offers will route to me and Kimberly for formal approval. Please ensure the comp upload goes into Workday and that recruiting flags the exception code.

Attach an interview schedule draft before EOD Tuesday and I’ll lock it.

-Marissa
VP, Talent Operations

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800

Marissa / Kimberly / team —

Appreciate the detail. I’m approving the provisional headcount addition and the one-time payband exception (+10% on base for the first Sr. SWE) on the condition that:

1) We track candidate funnel metrics weekly and present a 30/60/90 hiring status update to Finance.
2) Recruiting documents candidate acceptance reason (if comp was deciding factor) for our comp governance audit.
3) Olga and Marcus submit a short post-hire ROI write-up 90 days after start (impact on KV cache rollout and latency SLOs).

Proceed with interviews and offers — loop me in on offers above the approved uplift.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform & Operations
Quoted earlier messages are preserved in the thread. Attachments referenced: runtime-hc-proposal-v2.pdf, comp-band-uplift-analysis.xlsx, recruiting/luis-resume.pdf
